name: Hon-Komagome
tagline: Otemachi in 18 minutes and Tokyo in 19 minutes. Served by 1 line. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥90,000 to ¥100,000.
summary: The station is in Bunkyo City, where Tokyo Metro run 1 line between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 18 minutes to Otemachi, 22 minutes to Shinjuku, 29 minutes to Shibuya and 33 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥90,000 to ¥100,000. The station stands 24.3 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 4.8 m. The land around the station is close to level.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 24.3 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 19.9 m to 24.7 m, a difference of 4.8 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls outside the projected inundation area. Even so, 2 of the nine points within 400 m fall inside the area, and the deepest projection there is less than 0.5 m. On the whole, the flood projection here is among the smallest in the 23 wards.

groceries.name: コープみらい 白山店

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 14 clinics and 24 pharmacies. Day-to-day care is available close to the station. The nearest hospital is 日本医科大学附属病院, about 11 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 都立駒込病院, about 11 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 1 line serve the station: Tokyo Metro Namboku Line.
congestion: Tokyo Metro Namboku Line runs at 156% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch of the line is 駒込→本駒込, which includes this station. At 150%, the ministry's scale describes shoulders not quite touching, with crowding near the doors. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥90,000 to ¥100,000 and 1K ¥110,000 to ¥120,000. 1LDK ¥180,000 to ¥190,000 and 2LDK ¥230,000 to ¥240,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥90,000 to ¥100,000. Set against how long it takes to reach the central business districts, that is among the lowest in the 23 wards. a small projected flood depth and schools and parks within walking distance pushes the figure up. On the other side, only one line, the {line}, serving the station holds it down. For 1LDK, 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: Hakusan is ahead on how little of the area is in the flood projection, but Hon-Komagome is ahead on quiet.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Hon-Komagome. Hakusan has the Toei Mita Line, a different set from Hon-Komagome. To Otemachi, for instance, Hakusan is 8 minutes quicker. On quiet, Hon-Komagome comes out ahead.

neighbours.lead: Todaimae is ahead on how easy the shopping is.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Hon-Komagome. It is served by the same lines as Hon-Komagome. Journey times to the main business districts are much the same. A one-room flat costs about ¥5,000 less at Todaimae. On how easy the shopping is, Todaimae comes out ahead.

People living alone who want to hold the rent down
notFor: People who want another route when service is suspended
noiseSources: 本郷通り (2 lanes each way) runs right beside the station, so for a flat close to the station, check whether it faces the road
旧白山通り (1 lanes each way) runs just outside the station. In a flat facing it, the cars are audible morning and evening

leads.terrain: The ground around the station is almost level, so you can choose where to live without thinking about slopes.
leads.groceries: There are 10 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 2 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The station itself is outside the projected flood area, but blocks nearby are inside it.
leads.stationNote: Only the Tokyo Metro Namboku Line serves this station, so when it stops you walk to another station.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are among the lowest in the 23 wards.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is among the highest in the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Among the 23 wards' stations, the lines here are heavily loaded in the morning.
leads.noiseSources: At this station, check the traffic noise before the noise people make.
